description: Niche-informed product research for ecommerce. Polymath supplies corpus knowledge and owns durable run and hypothesis state; the connected agent reasons (θ); the ecommerce domain (adapters/ecommerce, through DOMAIN_OPERATION) supplies the seller's craft as deterministic law and planning — interpretation lineage, population discovery, bridge and portfolio admissibility, research planning, evidence cards and lived situations from ADMITTED evidence, the product-set law, sourcing plans, price / MOQ normalization and the lead join; the host harness investigates customers, products and supply with its own tools; TrailSignal alone admits evidence, judges hypotheses, qualifies and computes the only score or refusal (LAW 1). The domain computes and never owns state; no source, search engine, browser or harness is named here.

steps.title: Write every live hypothesis as an explicit bridge path
steps.objective: For EACH live hypothesis in context.hypotheses write its bridge: source, path[] (every hop written out, at least three hops, never seed -> product in one jump), target_mechanism (the mechanism FAMILY — variants of one mechanism are one hypothesis), evidence_boundary.first_inference_at (the FIRST hop that is inference, not evidence; it must be one of the hops), hop_refs {"0": [evidence ids], …} for every hop BEFORE the boundary, gaps[] (plain questions real communities could answer; enough to cover the hops past the boundary), alternatives[] (at least one competing explanation), falsifiers[] (the observation that would kill it), status WORKING_HYPOTHESIS (or WORKING_ANALOGY with exploratory: true for at most one deliberate transfer). Before any field evidence exists declare grounding: CORPUS_ONLY. The portfolio needs three to six hypotheses across DISTINCT mechanism families. If a previous bridge check listed errors, correct exactly those. Materials show `hypothesis_semantics` (each hypothesis's ledger state, origin leads and latent structures, and the run's transferable invariants): a bridge starts at the corpus evidence behind the hypothesis's latent structure and states the invariant it transfers.
constraints: One bridge per live hypothesis_id, no others

steps.title: Product ideation: the SET of distinct product directions, each with variations
steps.objective: Name the mechanisms the surviving hypotheses support: mechanisms[] = {id, name, hypothesis_id (a live hypothesis in context.hypotheses), evidence_refs (admitted field evidence ids), product_terms[]}. Then turn them into THREE to SIX DISTINCT product directions, product_concepts[] = {id, mechanism_id, name, form_factor (short noun phrase — the de-duplication key), target_moment (the cue moment it lives at), buyer (the sub-population), differentiator (why the generic version fails them — cite the friction), variations[] (at least two: {name, twist}), evidence_refs[] (at least one admitted field evidence id that grounds the moment or the friction)}. Distinct means a different form factor / moment / buyer — not the same organiser in five colours; variations that are only colour, size or price are not variations. Cover the physical jobs and the moments the evidence named. A concept with no admitted evidence behind it is forbidden. If a previous check listed errors, correct exactly those. Materials show `hypothesis_semantics`: the surviving hypotheses' current ledger state, physical jobs, origin and the primitives (workarounds, adaptations, latent values) that share their evidence — concepts must answer that state, not the seed.
constraints: mechanism hypothesis_id must be a live hypothesis; support is decided by the ledger, not by you
